transcript: Speaker A: Hey, I really like talking to you. Speaker B: Awww, same here. Speaker A: So when are we meeting in person? Speaker B: This weekend? Speaker A: Sure, perfect. [I mean I watch movies, and pass some time.] Speaker B: Oh, okay. Speaker A: How did... how did you come here? Speaker B: Ek baat poochu? Galat mat sochna. Aur thoda-thoda karke tumhara confidence badhane mein bhi help karti hai. [Oh, I was also like this before. But after that I started using English Seekho app. Vidya, my AI teacher. Then I will download it today.] Speaker B: Haan, aaj hi try karo English Seekho app. [Yes, try English Seekho app today.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download English Seekho app.]
